note: Rent ledger, net income and backups; no browser or iOS execution

results.name: Configuring rent creates unpaid monthly entries and a dashboard reminder without reducing income
Paid rent reduces its month and all-time net income once; clearing the switch restores both
After setup the rent amount cannot be corrected or re-saved: only payment confirmation remains
Future periods keep the amount set at setup and paid amounts remain unchanged
Six future months are created across year boundaries and advance automatically without duplicate expenses
Previously saved rent gains a six-month horizon without overwriting paid or corrected records
Paying an older rental period corrects that month rather than the actual activation month
A storage failure while confirming payment rolls the ledger back
Payment confirmation works independently for each period without any draft state
Foreground month rollover creates the new reminder and keeps existing amounts
Rent snapshots, manual backups and restore preserve configuration and payments; old backups migrate empty
Reloading saved data preserves paid rent and creates only new unpaid periods on a later month
Malformed or duplicate rent periods cannot replace valid data during import
Zero rent remains a paid status without generating a deduction or reminder for a future month
Rent-only months produce negative income and visible bounded negative bars and cumulative line
Mixed income across zero keeps both positive and negative bars visible and historical cumulative totals correct
